attributes.title: "ALL Hands On Deck!" 2027 Critical-Care Symposium
attributes.venue: The Founders Inn and Spa, Tapestry Collection by Hilton
attributes.summary:
The Tidewater Chapter of AACN holds its first "ALL Hands On Deck!" Critical-Care Symposium on February 19 and 20, 2027, at The Founders Inn and Spa in Virginia Beach. Topics include ventilator liberation, the ICU Liberation (A–F) bundle, delirium, post-ICU syndrome, healthy unit culture and caregiver wellbeing, with a nursing track and a PT/OT track on day two.

The program lists 12.0 contact hours, including 1.0 pharmacology, submitted to AACN for approval. Early-bird two-day rates (until December 6, 2026) are $250 for chapter members and $300 for others, rising to $300 and $350 afterwards; single-day tickets start at $150. AACN president Tonka Williams and podcast host Kali Dayton are among the announced speakers.
